ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-07-2009 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Terrance C. Heath, Esq. appeared with petitioner Lita Elizabeth Aguero, who was placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Elizabeth Aguero.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-24-2009 Reset To Apr-07-09 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William Gargano, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Lois Jones.
Terrance Heath, Esq. for Petitioner Lita Elizabeth Aguero, not present.
At Mr. Heath's request, matter is continued to April 7, 2009 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
